instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "See the next question my method asks about a decision, or, when all are answered, the options and my similar past decisions", and give it decision_id (The decision).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:next-decision-question and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads one of the person's decisions and returns its current question (step_id, question, fields, the checks to answer and their verdict words, the answer_schema), the person's current pursuits when the question weighs them, and the method coverage.

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: decision (records:read, records:list); decision-revision (records:read); decision-step (records:read); decision-evidence (records:read, records:list); decision-answered-step (records:read, records:list); decision-option (records:read, records:list); decision-candidate (records:read, records:list); decision-report (records:read, records:list); decision-carried-out (records:read, records:list); decision-history (records:read, records:list); decision-cited-pursuit (records:read, records:list); decision-method (records:read); decision-part (records:read); decision-refs (records:read); pursuit (records:read, records:list); record:check (records:list, records:read); record:decision-kind (records:list).
